responsibility: Declares the shared identifier-character classification interface used by the D front end when validating names under different language character rules. It defines the selectable identifier policy set (`UAX31`, `C99`, `C11`, and a least-restrictive mode) and the `IdentifierCharLookup` pair of function pointers that answer whether a Unicode code point may start or continue an identifier, giving parsers and identifier-validation code a compact way to switch between standards-specific character tables without embedding the tables in each consumer.
